listing.name: Reputation Decay
listing.summary: Makes reputation decay to 0 over time, with configurable rates and target values.
listing.aiSummary: Makes reputation decay to 0 over time, with configurable rates and target values.

description:
Download link

A simple mod that makes reputation decay to 0 over time. You can change the rate of the decay (default 1 per month) and whether reputation should decay to 0 at all times, or if it should decay to 75 or -75 if cooperative or vengeful (true by default).

Thanks Jaghaimo and Histidine.

aiDescription: This mod causes reputation to decay over time. Users can adjust the decay rate and choose whether reputation decays to zero or to specific thresholds like 75 or -75 depending on faction stance.
